TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT NARRATIVE
AND PLANS
3853 W. Palmer Street

The Applicant seeks to rezone 3853 W. Palmer Street, Chicago, IL from a RS-3 Residential Single-
Unit District to a RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District to establish two additional dwelling units
on the basement level. The property will be improved with a two-story residential building with
six (6) dwelling units and two (2) parking spaces. The height of the building is 26.6 feet. No
commercial space will be provided.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant seeks all relief available under the Chicago
Zoning Ordinance required for the plans subject to the zoning map amendment.
